## Unitary polynomial invariants are generated by pairings

[Theorem ALG.1197](https://andrewodesky.com/rh/lean/PositivityTheory.Rg.Sw.fft/)

Let $I,A,B$ be finite sets and $$p\in\mathbb C[x_{ia},y_{ib}:i\in I,\ a\in A,\ b\in B].$$ Suppose that, for every unitary matrix $u\in U(\mathbb C^I)$, $p$ is unchanged under the substitution $$x_{ia}\longmapsto\sum_j u_{ij}x_{ja},\qquad y_{ib}\longmapsto\sum_j\overline{u_{ij}}y_{jb}.$$ Then $p$ belongs to the $\mathbb C$-subalgebra generated by $$q_{ab}=\sum_{i\in I}x_{ia}y_{ib}\qquad(a\in A,\ b\in B).$$
